name: BookX
summary: Shopify appointment booking that lives in the storefront: Calendly-style slots for services, classes, rentals and events, with staff and multi-location schedules, deposits and partial payments, and the money taken at your own checkout. Bookings are unlimited on every tier; the ladder is gated on locations and team members.
best_for: Shopify merchants running appointment-based services (salons, studios, clinics, rentals, classes and events) who want the booking calendar inside the store they already sell from, with staff and multi-location schedules and payment taken at the Shopify checkout.
skip_if: you do not sell on Shopify; you need a booking system that stands on its own website and payment flow so customers who never visit your shop can still book; or you run more than twenty staff or locations and want a published price before you commit.
honest_knock: The free plan is a demonstration rather than a plan. One service and one team member means a salon with two stylists, or a studio running two class types, is already on Starter, so treat $4.99 a month as the real entry price, not zero. From there the ladder is gated on locations and team members rather than on how much you actually book: five, ten and twenty at $4.99, $9.99 and $19.99. A busy single-location business therefore pays the same as a quiet one, which is generous, while a small chain climbs the ladder for reasons that have nothing to do with volume. Above twenty locations or team members the published table stops and you have to ask. And the whole thing only exists inside Shopify (the calendar rides on your storefront, checkout and POS) so there is nothing here for a business that takes bookings anywhere else.

pricing.plans_source: hand-curated from the vendor's pricing page
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-11-02 on apps.shopify.com/appointment-booking-bookeasy; first read 2026-09-08) Every paid tier was halved since our earlier readings, which had Starter at $9.99, Growth at $19.99 and Business at $39.99. Four tiers billed in USD every 30 days, and the meter is locations and team members rather than bookings — every tier, the free one included, carries unlimited bookings. Free costs nothing and covers one service and one team member, minute or hour scheduling, lead and buffer time, email notifications, timezone and multi-language support, blockout dates and slots, and live support by chat, email and Zoom. Starter is $4.99 a month or $49.99 a year (the listing says save 17%) and lifts that to five locations and team members with unlimited services, full-day, multi-day and bundle bookings, Google Calendar and Zoom, book-now-pay-later and partial payments, customer reschedule and cancel, and a universal booking button. Growth is $9.99 or $99.99 a year (17%) for ten locations and team members, deposits and multi-payment options, workflows and a custom email sender, Shopify Flow and POS, seasonal pricing and advanced bundle and multi-day conditions. Business is $19.99 or $199.99 a year (17%) for twenty locations and team members, the all-in-one booking widget, two-way Google Calendar sync per team member, advanced seasonal pricing, Klaviyo and webhook integrations and priority support. Every paid tier has a 14-day free trial. What the table does not publish is what happens above twenty locations or team members: the ladder simply ends there. Reviews: 621 at an overall 5.0 on 2 November 2026, 598 of them five-star and 6 one-star.

compare_with.name: SimplyBook.me
compare_with.why: SimplyBook.me is a standalone booking platform with its own booking page, client records and payment providers, and it works whatever you sell on. BookX makes sense the other way round: you are already committed to Shopify and you want the calendar, the staff schedule and the money to sit inside that storefront instead of beside it. The trade is reach against integration: SimplyBook.me can take a booking from someone who never sees your shop, BookX cannot, but BookX takes the payment through the checkout you already run and keeps the appointment in the same admin as the order

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested BookX on a Shopify development store: the install, onboarding with generated time slots and an automatically created service, the plan screen with a 50 percent promotion, the Shopify approval screen for Starter (not approved), the Free plan and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was paid and nothing was saved in the theme. Install: the App Store listing (English) is BookX, from Logbase. Install was clicked at about 12:11:32 in our own tab; the Install app dialog asked for customer data, staff and contributor data and store data, and was approved. A contact form Tell us about yourself was skipped with Skip for now. A banner says: This app is free for development stores. When you are ready to go live, all services will be hidden until you choose a plan and approve subscription. Core action: onboarding with Minute / Hour booking (the default), Generate time slots (10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, 30 minutes, Monday to Friday) and Generate; a booking product was created by the app because Dont have a booking product? We will create one automatically for this service was ticked; payment Full Payment (the default) and Create service. The app said Service created successfully. The Services list shows BookX First Service with the product Appointment and the status Active, and the slots of 30 minutes show on Monday and Friday in the Slot configuration. Timing, approximate tester observations: about 2 minutes from choosing the plan (12:12) to the created service (12:14), in about 8 clicks; about 3 minutes from the install click. The step Activate BookX in the Shopify Theme said BookX App Embed is not enabled in the selected theme; we chose Continue & Enable Later, so nothing was saved in the theme and the widget was not seen in the theme preview. The notification email was not filled in. Plans: the Pricing plans screen shows Free (Unlimited Bookings, 1 service and 1 team member), Starter at $4.99 a month with $9.99 struck through, 50% OFF, You save $60.00/yr and 14 day free trial, and Growth at $9.99 a month with $19.99 struck through and You save $120.00/yr. A banner says Get 50% off our regular price for lifetime and Ends 30 nov, 19:29 CET. Starter lists Upto 5 Team Members, Upto 5 Locations, Book now Pay later, Partial Payment, Bundle bookings and Full / Multi Day bookings; Growth adds 10 members and locations, Deposit, Shopify Flow, Shopify POS, Basic seasonal pricing and Multiple Payment options. So the regular prices are $9.99 for Starter and $19.99 for Growth; the dossier prices of $4.99 and $9.99 are the promotion prices until 30 November. Checkout: Get 50% off on Starter opened the Shopify Approve subscription screen: 50% off all charges, plan Starter plan, $9,99 struck through and $5,00 USD every 30 days, You have a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec., subtotal $9,99 plus any applicable taxes, discount 50% off -$5,00, total $5,00 due 1 Dec., and an Add payment method row. The sentence about a test charge was NOT on this screen and Approve was greyed out, so we did not approve. Cancel gave a red message, The shop cannot accept the provided charge., and we went back to the plan choice through the app address. We chose the Free plan with Continue; no charge was approved. Cancelling: no subscription ran, because the Free plan was used. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, Uninstall; the dialog Uninstall BookX? says you will no longer be able to use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the developer within 48 hours to delete personal customer information. A reason is required (Testing multiple apps). Not tested: the widget in the theme preview, a real booking and checkout, paid features (deposit, seasonal pricing, Google Calendar sync), several team members and locations, the Mandatory Checks (switching off dynamic checkout) and the contact form. Clean up: the app was uninstalled at about 12:15 and is gone from the installed apps; the service went with it. No theme change was saved. Our own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The promotion prices of $4.99 and $9.99 end on 30 November and the regular prices are twice as high, the approval screen asks for a payment method and has no test charge sentence, and after Cancel the shop shows an error message.
